faq.question: How will I receive my 100% refund?
faq.answer: Through the original mode of payment, once you complete the course and submit the assignments, exercises and projects within the time period.

faq.question: Will my course access expire after I get the refund?
faq.answer: No — you keep lifetime access to the course and your mentor's support, even after you've received your 100% refund.

faq.question: Do I need prior experience to start?
faq.answer: No. Courses start from the fundamentals and build up, so you can begin from scratch.

faq.question: How do I access my mentor?
faq.answer: Industry mentors come live in the evening and connect with you 1:1 — you can clear doubts by chat, audio or screen-sharing. Timings vary, mainly 7–10pm, Monday to Saturday.
